purpose: Verified contract for explaining material changes between approved property answer snapshots.
comparison_rule: Compare immutable approved snapshots and preserve predecessor identity.
cause_rule: A change explanation identifies a cause only when supported by an approved evidence, legal or recorded change dependency.
evidence_rule: Evidence change and legal-rule change remain distinct.
historical_rule: Historical answers remain anchored to their target date and applicable legal version.
unchanged_rule: Material unchanged components may be identified to prevent overstatement of the change.
uncertainty_rule: An unresolved cause remains explicitly unresolved.
verification_boundary: The change explanation describes approved snapshot differences; it does not create a new legal conclusion.
